quote: Life is short. Smile while you still have teeth.
Your mind is like a parachute—it works best when open.
Don’t take life too seriously. You’ll never get out of it alive anyway.
Some days you eat salad and go to the gym, other days you eat cupcakes and refuse to put on pants. Balance is key.
Even the calendar says W-T-F in the middle of the week.
Be yourself. Everyone else is already taken.
The elevator to success is out of order. You’ll have to use the stairs… one step at a time.
I am an early bird and a night owl… so I am wise and I have worms.
Don’t worry if plan A fails—there are 25 more letters in the alphabet.
If you think you are too small to make a difference, try sleeping with a mosquito in the room.
A day without laughter is a day wasted.
You don’t have to be perfect to be amazing.
Common sense is like deodorant. The people who need it most never use it.
You can’t make everyone happy. You’re not pizza.
Always borrow money from a pessimist—they won’t expect it back.
If at first you don’t succeed, then skydiving definitely isn’t for you.
The road to success is dotted with many tempting parking spaces.
When nothing goes right… go left.
Life is like a cup of tea. It’s all in how you make it.
Behind every great man is a woman rolling her eyes.
You can’t have everything… where would you put it?
Age is merely the number of years the world has been enjoying you.
Don’t count the days, make the days count. And maybe count snacks instead.
If life gives you lemons, make lemonade. Then find someone whose life gave them vodka.
Some people just need a high-five. In the face. With a chair. (But only in your imagination!)
The best way to predict your future is to create it… and add Wi-Fi.
Stress spelled backwards is desserts. Coincidence? I think not.
Be the kind of person your dog thinks you are.
You can’t have a rainbow without a little rain… and probably a leaky umbrella.
Do more things that make you forget to check your phone.
Some people dream of success, while others wake up and hit snooze.
The early bird might get the worm, but the second mouse gets the cheese.
Your vibe attracts your tribe… so maybe stop being grumpy.
Opportunity is missed by most people because it is dressed in overalls and looks like work.
Happiness is homemade… preferably with chocolate.
Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep balance, you must keep moving… and avoid potholes.
Some minds are like concrete—thoroughly mixed and permanently set.
Don’t follow the crowd. Let the crowd follow you… preferably to the pizza shop.
There are no traffic jams on the extra mile… unless it’s Monday morning.
Life always offers you a second chance. It’s called tomorrow… unless you forget to set your alarm.
If you can’t be a pencil to write someone’s happiness, try to be an eraser to remove their sadness.
Don’t let yesterday take up too much of today. Netflix will gladly do that for you.
Sometimes you just need to lie on the couch and do nothing… and that’s productivity too.
Be a fruit loop in a world full of Cheerios.
Life is uncertain. Eat dessert first.
Failure is the condiment that gives success its flavor… preferably with fries.
Don’t wait for opportunity. Create it… and put glitter on it.
Always remember you’re unique, just like everyone else.
The best way to cheer yourself is to try to cheer somebody else up… with memes.
Life is better when you’re laughing—preferably at your own jokes.
You are enough just as you are.
Every day may not be good, but there is something good in every day.
Your present circumstances don’t determine where you can go; they merely determine where you start.
The struggle you’re in today is developing the strength you need for tomorrow.
Happiness is not the absence of problems, but the ability to deal with them.
You are braver than you believe, stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
Small progress is still progress.
Don’t be pushed around by the fears in your mind. Be led by the dreams in your heart.
You don’t have to control your thoughts; you just have to stop letting them control you.
Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
It’s okay to not be okay, as long as you are not giving up.
Healing takes time, and that’s okay.
No rain, no flowers.
Your mental health is just as important as your physical health.
Breathe. It’s just a bad day, not a bad life.
The darkest nights produce the brightest stars.
Be kind to yourself; you are doing the best you can.
You deserve to rest, just as much as you deserve to work hard.
A little progress each day adds up to big results.
Your potential is endless. Go do what you were created to do.
Self-love is not selfish; you cannot truly love another until you know how to love yourself.
It’s never too late to be what you might have been.
One step at a time. You don’t have to figure everything out at once.
Your past does not define you; your present does.
There is hope, even when your brain tells you there isn’t.
Sometimes, the best thing you can do is not think, not wonder, not imagine, just breathe and have faith.
Your feelings are valid. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
You are not your thoughts. You are the observer of your thoughts.
Be gentle with yourself; you are doing the best you can.
You are growing through what you are going through.
Positivity is a choice. Make it daily.
Trust the process. Everything is unfolding as it should.
Sometimes, the most productive thing you can do is relax.
You are allowed to take up space.
Talk to yourself like someone you love.
You are not alone. You are loved.
Your worth is not measured by your productivity.
Healing isn’t linear, and that’s okay.
You are capable of more than you know.
Surround yourself with people who lift you up.
A positive mindset brings positive things.
Sometimes, the bravest thing you can do is ask for help.
It’s not selfish to put yourself first sometimes.
Even the smallest step forward is still progress.
You have survived 100% of your worst days. Keep going.
Love yourself enough to set boundaries.
You are in charge of how you feel today.
Nothing is permanent. Not even your struggles.
Give yourself permission to rest.
Find joy in the little things.
